conventions.positive-golden: tests/conformance/<edition>/<name>.cob + <name>.out; the directory selects --std. First line a comment `*> ISO §<clause> <rule> — <what is exercised>`. Unique PROGRAM-ID per program (a stale same-named assembly is served otherwise). Deterministic output only. Do NOT edit any manifest.json — return the entry; the director registers it.
conventions.negative-golden: tests/conformance/negative/<name>.cob + <name>.err (the expected diagnostic substring, e.g. COBOLNET1560). FIRST line of the .cob MUST be `*> reject-at: <year> [<year> ...]`. Do NOT edit the negative manifest — return the entry.
conventions.test-ref-forms: conformance:<edition>/<case> (positive, spec-derived) · conformance:negative/<case> · unit:<Class>.<Method> · conformance-test:<Class>.<Method>. nist:/characterization: and any *_MatchesLegacy method are NOT spec-derived and cannot close a row.
conventions.compiler: src/Cobol.Net.Cli/bin/Debug/net10.0/cobol.exe <file.cob> --std <85|2002|2014|2023> --run  (run in a scratch dir; never dotnet build/test — the tree is shared and a guard refuses builds while a fleet is live).
conventions.citation-check: python scripts/spec/cite.py --check <clause> "<quoted text>"  — every § you cite, no exceptions.

Determination evidence (PB1522 step 3): Optional element not provided; row opens 'Not provided.' so the PB280 Q1 a1-optional-not-provided selector derives DOCUMENTED-NON-SUPPORT once recorded (the integrator may record that verdict instead). Verified: RecordLayout.PhysicalWidth sums widths with no alignment term; probe /tmp/adj/doc/doc-w1-s1/probe/i7.cob (X, S9(9) COMP-5, X, COMP-2 without SYNCHRONIZED) BYTE-LENGTH=14 at --std 2002 and 2023 (1+4+1+8, no automatic alignment). With SYNCHRONIZED also no padding (conformance:2002/l1_byte_length_implicit_filler SYNC=3, which pins item 195, not this item — so Pinned-by is —). cite.py --check 8.5.1.6.4 OK (2), 13.18.55.4 OK (10). Owning note: A11.

rows.subject: I-O status 0x (value of x)
rows.adjudicator-notes: Derived: a1-optional-not-provided (kb/Work PB280 Q1 — an A.1-OPTIONAL item whose §7 row opens 'Not provided.' is DOCUMENTED-NON-SUPPORT). Determination evidence (PB1522 step 3): §9.1.13.3 1) (cite.py OK 'The value of x is specified by the implementor') is optional; COBOL.NET provides no 0x value. Verified: FileStatusCode's constants are exactly 00 02 04 05 06 07 09 10 14 21 22 23 24 30 31 34 35 37 38 39 41 42 43 44 46 47 48 49 51 52 53 54 61 62 71 90, and grep for a quoted "0[A-Ma-m]" over src finds none. Row states non-provision per the PB280 Q1 convention (DOCUMENTED-NON-SUPPORT via the a1-optional-not-provided selector). No pinning test (a negative can only be witnessed by the absence of a producer), hence Pinned by —. Owning note PB1534 / PB1522 step 3.

rows.adjudicator-notes: Derived: a1-optional-not-provided (kb/Work PB280 Q1 — an A.1-OPTIONAL item whose §7 row opens 'Not provided.' is DOCUMENTED-NON-SUPPORT). Determination evidence (PB1522 step 3): A.1-143 is OPTIONAL, so owner decision kb/Work PB280 Q1 governs: a 'Not provided.' row, which the derived selector a1-optional-not-provided turns into DOCUMENTED-NON-SUPPORT (kb/Work PB1536 also lists 143, but its Q1 concerns CONDITIONALLY-required items; 143's class is optional). §8.3.2.2.21 (cite.py OK) leaves the formation rules to the implementor 'for a non-COBOL program'. Probe probe/nc.cob --std 2023: CALL "Antlr4.Runtime.Standard" and CALL "System.Console" take ON EXCEPTION; SET PP TO ADDRESS OF PROGRAM "System.Console" -> NULL. ProgramTable.ProbeSiblingModule requires a COBOL.NET registrar. No golden pins the non-provision.

rows.subject: SYNCHRONIZED clause (how records of a file are handled)
rows.adjudicator-notes: Derived: a1-optional-not-provided (kb/Work PB280 Q1 — an A.1-OPTIONAL item whose §7 row opens 'Not provided.' is DOCUMENTED-NON-SUPPORT). Determination evidence (PB1522 step 3): Optional item not provided (PB280 Q1 convention). cite.py --check 13.18.55.4 'Any rules for synchronization of the records of a file' -> OK §13.18.55.4 11). Code: DataBinder.cs:4067 the sole syncClause() site sets the bare DataItem.Synchronized bool; no layout or file-layer code reads it for a record. Probe probe/p196/fr.cob at --std 85 and 2023: record X / S9(4) COMP SYNC / X written as 51 01 02 5a (4 bytes, no pad). Consistent with the DOC-A.1-195 row's 'GR11 adds no file-level synchronization'. Nothing pins a file record specifically, so Pinned by is empty. kb/Work/PB538 (open analysis, claims DOC-A.1-196) names this absent row as its documentation half. Owning note: kb/Work/PB538.
rows.rule-text: SYNCHRONIZED clause (how records of a file are handled). This item is optional. This item, if provided by the implementor, shall be documented in the implementor's user documentation. (13.18.55, SYNCHRONIZED clause, General rule 11)

posture: A DOCUMENTED-NON-SUPPORT row closes ONLY on a test proving we DIAGNOSE the declined construct (or that the documented behaviour is what actually happens). Read the two owning notes first; they carry the licence and the source shapes to measure.
